Pembagian Data Train dan Test

n_train <- round(0.86 * n)
n_test <- n - n_train

n_train

n_test

data_test <- data_kurs[(n_train + 1):n, ]

train.ts <- ts(data_train$Kurs)
test.ts <- ts(data_test$Kurs)

Eksplorasi Data

Plot Data Penuh

plot.ts(
  ts(data_kurs$Kurs),
  lty = 1,
  xlab = "Waktu",
  ylab = "Kurs",
  main = "Plot Data Kurs JISDOR No. 196-390"
)

### Plot Data Latih

plot.ts(
  train.ts,
  lty = 1,
  xlab = "Waktu",
  ylab = "Kurs",
  main = "Plot Data Kurs Train"
)

Plot Data Uji

plot.ts(
  test.ts,
  lty = 1,
  xlab = "Waktu",
  ylab = "Kurs",
  main = "Plot Data Kurs Test"
)

Uji Stasioneritas Data

Plot ACF DataTrain

acf(
  train.ts,
  main = "ACF Data Kurs Train",
  lag.max = 20
)

Plot ADF Data Train

adf_level <- tseries::adf.test(train.ts)

adf_level
## 
##  Augmented Dickey-Fuller Test
## 
## data:  train.ts
## Dickey-Fuller = -1.3416, Lag order = 5, p-value = 0.8511
## alternative hypothesis: stationary
adf_level$p.value
## [1] 0.8511081

Plot Box Cox

index <- seq(1, length(train.ts))

bc <- boxcox(
  train.ts ~ index,
  lambda = seq(0.5, 2, by = 0.1)
)

# Lambda optimum
lambda_opt <- bc$x[which.max(bc$y)]

lambda_opt
## [1] 0.5
# Selang kepercayaan 95%
ci_lambda <- bc$x[
  bc$y > max(bc$y) - 0.5 * qchisq(0.95, df = 1)
]

ci_lower <- min(ci_lambda)
ci_upper <- max(ci_lambda)

c(
  Lambda_Optimum = lambda_opt,
  Batas_Bawah = ci_lower,
  Batas_Atas = ci_upper
)
## Lambda_Optimum    Batas_Bawah     Batas_Atas 
##            0.5            0.5            2.0

  train.diff,
  lty = 1,
  xlab = "Waktu",
  ylab = "Difference 1 Kurs",

  train.diff,
  main = "ACF Difference 1 Kurs",
  lag.max = 20
)

# Uji ADF Setelah Differencing

adf_diff

adf_diff$p.value

  main = "PACF Difference 1 Kurs",

)

  sisaan,
  col = "blue",
  lwd = 2
)

# Plot sisaan
plot(
  sisaan,
  type = "l",
  main = "Plot Sisaan",
  xlab = "Waktu",
  ylab = "Sisaan"
)

# ACF sisaan
acf(
  sisaan,
  main = "ACF Sisaan"
)

# PACF sisaan
pacf(
  sisaan,
  main = "PACF Sisaan"
)

par(mfrow = c(1,1))

Uji Formal Sisaan

Uji Normalitas Sisaan

ks.test(
  sisaan,
  "pnorm",
  mean(sisaan),
  sd(sisaan)
)
## 
##  Asymptotic one-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test
## 
## data:  sisaan
## D = 0.11154, p-value = 0.03137
## alternative hypothesis: two-sided

Uji Kebebasan Sisaan

Box.test(
  sisaan,
  type = "Ljung"
)
## 
##  Box-Ljung test
## 
## data:  sisaan
## X-squared = 0.013809, df = 1, p-value = 0.9065

Uji Kehomogenan Ragam Sisaan

Box.test(
  sisaan^2,
  type = "Ljung"
)
## 
##  Box-Ljung test
## 
## data:  sisaan^2
## X-squared = 2.5833, df = 1, p-value = 0.108

Uji Nilai Tengah Sisaan

t.test(
  sisaan,
  mu = 0,
  conf.level = 0.95
)
## 
##  One Sample t-test
## 
## data:  sisaan
## t = -0.0065474, df = 166, p-value = 0.9948
## alternative hypothesis: true mean is not equal to 0
## 95 percent confidence interval:
##  -7.791184  7.739680
## sample estimates:
##   mean of x 
## -0.02575192

Inverse Differencing

pt_akhir_train <- tail(
  train.ts,
  1
)

forecast_asli <- diffinv(
  data.ramalan,
  differences = 1,
  xi = pt_akhir_train
)

hasil_forecast <- forecast_asli[-1]

hasil_forecast <- hasil_forecast[
  1:length(test.ts)
]

hasil_forecast
